name: v1.2.0 — Power-up pickups + Obstáculos estáticos
generation_strategy: Canvas único 1536×1024 dividido en cuadrícula 6×1 (fila única) de celdas 256×256. 6 sprites en fila 0, filas 1–3 vacías. Recortar con Sharp según crop_regions.

frames.role: Power-up pickups (SHIELD, TOXIC, INVIS) + Obstáculos estáticos (BUNKER, BARRIER, ROUND)
frames.prompt:
Sprite sheet atlas on a 1536x1024 fully transparent canvas. Art style: cartoon/cel-shaded, bold 3-4px black outlines (#1A1A2E), vibrant saturated colors, chunky proportions, Brawl Stars visual quality. Strict 90-degree bird's eye overhead view for all obstacle sprites. Canvas uses a 6-column × 4-row grid of equal 256×256 cells; thin 1px semi-transparent gray lines mark cell boundaries as guides only. Each cell contains exactly ONE labeled sprite centered within it, with transparent background outside the sprite art.

COLUMNS x-ranges: Col0=0..256, Col1=256..512, Col2=512..768, Col3=768..1024, Col4=1024..1280, Col5=1280..1536
ROWS y-ranges: Row0=0..256, Row1=256..512, Row2=512..768, Row3=768..1024

--- ROW 0 — Power-up Pickups (Cols 0-2) + Static Obstacles (Cols 3-5) ---

[Row0, Col0] POWER_SHIELD_PICKUP: A glowing orb pickup representing a Shield power-up. Strictly bird's-eye top-down view — a circular orb seen from directly above. Bright electric cyan (#00E5FF) translucent bubble orb, semi-transparent interior with bright center highlight, concentric thin ring outlines in cyan-white. In the center, a simplified shield symbol (flat chevron/kite shape) in solid white with a 2px black outline. Outer glow halo in cyan-blue. Bold 3px black outline on main bubble silhouette. Cartoon style, very vibrant and glowing. 210×210px centered in 256×256 cell. Transparent background.

[Row0, Col1] POWER_TOXIC_PICKUP: A glowing orb pickup representing a Toxic Shot power-up. Strictly bird's-eye top-down view — a circular orb from directly above. Bright neon green (#39FF14) radioactive glowing orb, vibrant and sickly-green, semi-transparent with a bright inner core. In the center, a simplified biohazard symbol (three rounded arcs around a circle) in solid dark green (#003300) with thick 2px black outline. Outer neon-green glow halo pulsing outward. Bold 3px black outline on main orb silhouette. Cartoon style, intensely luminous green. 210×210px centered in 256×256 cell. Transparent background.

[Row0, Col2] POWER_INVIS_PICKUP: A glowing orb pickup representing an Invisibility power-up. Strictly bird's-eye top-down view — a circular orb from directly above. Soft lavender-purple (#AA88FF) translucent orb, partially see-through with a ghostly shimmer, swirling light pattern inside. In the center, a simplified wide-open eye icon (oval with a circular iris, minimalist flat style) in white with 2px black outline. Outer purple-pink glow halo. Bold 3px black outline on silhouette. Cartoon style, mysterious and ethereal. 210×210px centered in 256×256 cell. Transparent background.

[Row0, Col3] OBS_BUNKER: A fortified military bunker seen strictly from directly above at 90 degrees — bird's eye top-down view ONLY. Only the flat roof surface is visible, NO front face, NO side walls visible. The bunker is a horizontal rectangle approximately 180×120px (width greater than height) centered in the 256×256 cell. Flat roof surface in dark slate blue-gray (#3A3A4F), with visible concrete texture details: thick armored edge trim/border (10px wide, slightly lighter #4A4A5F), two rectangular ventilation slits near the top edge, a central circular hatch outline with a small handle bar, and 4 rivet/bolt circles at corners. Bold 4px black outline around the full perimeter. Cartoon/cel-shaded, chunky industrial look. Transparent background.

[Row0, Col4] OBS_BARRIER: A concrete jersey barrier seen strictly from directly above at 90 degrees — bird's eye top-down view ONLY. Only the very top flat surface is visible, NO side profile. The barrier top-down shape is an elongated narrow rectangle: approximately 220×30px (width much greater than height), centered horizontally in the 256×256 cell. Flat concrete top surface in warm concrete gray-brown (#6B5B45), with a thin center groove line running lengthwise (2px darker line), subtle concrete texture markings, and two small steel rebar tips visible at each end. Bold 3px black outline around full perimeter. Cartoon/cel-shaded, solid and heavy. Transparent background.

[Row0, Col5] OBS_ROUND: A massive round stone boulder or concrete pillar seen strictly from directly above at 90 degrees — bird's eye top-down view ONLY. Only the circular flat top surface is visible, NO sides. The shape is a perfect circle approximately 190×190px centered in 256×256 cell. Dark charcoal gray (#3D3D3D) flat circular top with visible cracks/fracture lines radiating from center (2px dark lines), subtle rough texture shading, a slightly lighter highlight circle in the center to suggest convexity from above, and darker shadow ring near the perimeter edge. Bold 4px black outline on the circle perimeter. Cartoon/cel-shaded, heavy and immovable looking. Transparent background.

--- ROWS 1-3: Fully transparent, empty cells reserved for future use ---
frames.negative_prompt: side view, isometric, 3/4 angle, front face visible, perspective tilt, any angle other than directly overhead, realistic, photorealistic, pixel art, military realism, dark gritty, solid black background, text labels, watermarks, speech bubbles, human figures, weapons

notes: Después de aprobar el draft, generar con quality:high. Recortar con Sharp: extraer cada región de 256×256, trim de transparencias, luego resize fit:contain al png_size (2× del game_display) con background transparente y kernel lanczos3. NO escalar directamente al game_display — guardar siempre al png_size para evitar pixelación. Cargar en PreloadScene como 'power-shield', 'power-toxic', 'power-invis', 'obs-bunker', 'obs-barrier', 'obs-round'. El servidor envía w/h del game_display y Phaser hace setDisplaySize(w, h).
